CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.TITLE: Appointments kit
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.DESCRIPTION: Gets appointments ready to use: contact attributes and WhatsApp templates to notify the customer when an appointment is booked or cancelled.
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.QUESTION: Notify the customer on WhatsApp when an appointment is booked or cancelled?
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.QUESTION_HINT: If you pick an inbox, we send the confirmation and cancellation templates to Meta for approval. Each notice goes out once its template is approved.
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.NO_INBOX: This account has no WhatsApp Cloud inboxes.
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.SENT: Templates sent to Meta. Approval can take a few minutes.
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.SENT_WITH_ERRORS: Some inboxes could not be sent. Check the red notices.
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.SEND_ERROR: The templates could not be sent. Try again.
CALENDAR_ACTIVATION_KIT.LOAD_ERROR: The appointments kit could not be loaded.

ERRORS.token_invalid: The WhatsApp access expired. Reconnect the inbox.
ERRORS.permission_denied: The WhatsApp account has no permission to create templates.
ERRORS.rate_limited: Meta received too many requests. Try again later.
ERRORS.name_exists: A template with that name already exists in that language.
ERRORS.name_locked: That name was deleted recently and Meta keeps it locked for 30 days.
ERRORS.template_limit: You reached the template limit of your WhatsApp account.
ERRORS.not_found: Meta could not find the WhatsApp account of this inbox.
ERRORS.meta_unreachable: Meta could not be reached. Try again.
ERRORS.unknown: Meta did not accept the template.
